The Chinese characters for Daniel

As a transliteration, Daniel is usually written 丹尼尔 (Dān ní ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

丹
Dān
cinnabar, red
尼
ní
nun (transliteration)
尔
ěr
you, thus

Origin and meaning

From Hebrew, Daniel carries the meaning “God is my judge”.

About the name Daniel

In the Bible, Daniel survived the lions' den and interpreted dreams.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Daniel carries the meaning “God is my judge” and looks striking in brush strokes.
